title: At the Gym
description: Four short recordings at a gym: joining, a trainer's talk, two members chatting and an announcement.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Joining the gym
parts.intro: You will hear Ben talking to the receptionist, Kate, at a gym.

script.speaker: Kate
script.text: Hello, welcome to Fit Zone. Are you here to join?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Yes. A friend told me about this gym. How much is it?

script.speaker: Kate
script.text: It's thirty pounds a month, or three hundred pounds for a year if you pay now.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Hmm, I'd like to try one month first. Is there a student price?

script.speaker: Kate
script.text: Yes, students pay twenty-five pounds a month. Do you have a student card?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Yes, here it is.

script.speaker: Kate
script.text: Thank you. The gym is open from six in the morning until ten at night, and we're open on Sundays too, but only until six in the evening.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Great. Can I use the swimming pool?

script.speaker: Kate
script.text: Of course. The pool is included, but the sauna costs two pounds extra each time.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: That's fine. I just want to swim and use the machines.

script.speaker: Kate
script.text: Wonderful. Please fill in this form, and don't forget to bring a towel next time. We don't give them out.

parts.title: Part 2 · The first session
parts.intro: You will hear a trainer, Alex, talking to new members.

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Hi, everybody, and welcome to your first session. My name is Alex and I'm one of the trainers here.

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Before you start, let me explain a few rules. First, always warm up for about ten minutes. You can use the running machines or the bikes. Many injuries happen because people don't warm up.

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Second, drink water often. You can fill your bottle at the machine near the door. Third, if you're not sure how to use a machine, please ask. We're always happy to help, so don't be shy.

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: For beginners, I recommend training three times a week, for about forty-five minutes. Don't do too much on the first day. You will probably feel tired and have sore legs tomorrow, but that's normal.

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Please wipe the machines after you use them, and put the weights back in the right place. And finally, phones are fine for music, but please don't make calls in the gym room.

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Any questions? No? Great, let's start with the warm-up.

parts.title: Part 3 · Two members
parts.intro: You will hear two gym members, Dan and Linh, talking after their workout.

script.speaker: Dan
script.text: Hi, Linh! I didn't know you came to this gym.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Hi, Dan! I started two months ago. My doctor said I should do more exercise because I sit at a desk all day.

script.speaker: Dan
script.text: Same here. I've been coming for six months. At first I hated it, but now I love it.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Really? I still find the machines boring. I prefer the classes.

script.speaker: Dan
script.text: Which classes do you do?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Yoga on Tuesdays and dancing on Thursdays. The dancing is so much fun, but I'm terrible at it!

script.speaker: Dan
script.text: I'd like to try yoga, but I'm not very flexible. I can't even touch my toes.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Neither could I at first! The teacher is very patient. You should come with me next Tuesday at seven.

script.speaker: Dan
script.text: OK, maybe. What time does it finish? I have football on Tuesdays at nine.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Eight o'clock, so you have plenty of time. Do you want to get a coffee now?

script.speaker: Dan
script.text: Sorry, I can't. I must get home for dinner. How about after yoga next week?

parts.title: Part 4 · A gym announcement
parts.intro: You will hear an announcement for the members of a gym.

script.speaker: Rachel
script.text: Good evening, members of Fit Zone. Here is some news about next month.

script.speaker: Rachel
script.text: First, we have a new timetable for our classes. Yoga will now be on Monday and Wednesday evenings, not Tuesday. The dance class stays on Thursday, but it will start at half past six instead of seven.

script.speaker: Rachel
script.text: Second, we have a new class for people over sixty. It's called Easy Move, and it's every morning at ten. It's free for the first week.

script.speaker: Rachel
script.text: Third, the swimming pool will be closed next Saturday for cleaning. It will reopen on Sunday at noon.

script.speaker: Rachel
script.text: Finally, we're having a charity run in the park on the second Sunday of next month. Members can take part for free, and friends can join for five pounds. All the money will go to the children's hospital.

script.speaker: Rachel
script.text: Please speak to a trainer if you'd like to join. Thank you, and enjoy your workout.
